entry.title: With DLSS 5, Nvidia look to rewrite the truth before our eyes
entry.summary: Earlier this year Nvidia announced DLSS 5, a new version of their DLSS technology: a layer of graphical magic that uses their GPUs to do improbable things to the resolution and framerate of your favourite PC games (unless your favourite PC game is Slay the Spire). Nvidia are in a strange space at the moment - now one of the most valuable companies to ever have existed, they're also one of the drivers of the AI boom and all of the horror and chaos that comes with it. PC gamers, once their core market, are now finding it harder than ever to afford their products, as Nvidia spent most of the last decade overselling first to crypto miners, and then to AI startups. On paper, DLSS 5 is a chance for a simple PR win, a positive example of using AI to improve the performance of modern videogames. Instead, they offered an opportunity to make every game you own slightly uglier, and only if you can afford the dual-GPUs it requires to run. DLSS 5 is fascinating not just as an extension of Nvidia’s AI-first business philosophy, and not just as a sign of the slowdown in hardware advancement, and not just because of what it says about our desire for 'more real than real' graphics. DLSS 5 also reflects the world we find ourselves in today, perhaps the most neatly-packed microcosm I’ve seen to date. entry.title: How to complete Fifteen Men on a Dead Man’s Chest in Windrose
entry.summary:
Fifteen Men on a Dead Man's Chest is one of the early-game side quests you can complete in Windrose. It's a relatively simple task, as the location will be marked on the map. However, it can still be a tricky task if you don't know what needs to be done.
This guide will help you to complete the side quest and unlock all the available rewards.
Windrose Fifteen Men on a Dead Man's Chest quest walkthrough
The Fifteen Men on a Dead Man's Chest is a single task quest where you need to find the Pirate's Chest. You'll find several chests on your adventure, but this one is specific. You can begin the quest after checking out the details for the Journal option.
Once the quest is active, you'll find a quest marker on the map. It's located in the center of the island, and you'll find four skeletons at the location. Use your shovel and start digging the ground. Once the topsoil is gone, you'll reveal a chest.
Screenshot by Destructoid
When you try to open the chest, the skeletons will be reincarnated as enemies. These aren't the strongest enemies you'll face, but they can still be quite dangerous. Deal with them, and try to focus on one skeleton at a time. Once they're dead, you can now open the chest as intended, and this will complete the Fifteen Men on a Dead Man's Chest quest.
Image via Kraken Express
When you kill the skeletons, you'll get resources like Undead Essence. However, you'll also get rewards from the chest.
Five Guinea
Four Silver Ingots
50 XP
Out of all available items, Silver Ingots are the most valuable of all items since you'll need them to craft and upgrade jewelry.

FC 26 has a maintenance on April 15, and the servers will be taken down for a significant time. The exact purpose of this maintenance, which comes right before TOTS, remains unknown. However, what we do know is the schedule, and more importantly, when the servers will be back online.

FC 26 server maintenance details (April 15)
Today's maintenance will begin at 11pm PT(April 14)/1am CT/2am ET/7am UTC as per the instructions from EA Sports. Matchmaking will be disabled 30 minutes prior to these timings, and you won't be able to enjoy any mode that requires online connectivity.

Today's maintenance will affect FC 26 on all platforms, and it includes every online game mode. If you try to matchmake in modes like Ultimate Team, it will result in an error. Alternatively, you might fail to enter Ultimate Team in the first place. The same also applies to other modes like Clubs, which also require you to connect to the servers.

How to craft the Torn Silcloth Bag in Windrose
The first way to increase inventory size is by using the Torn Sailcloth Bag. This item adds four extra slots to your inventory. You'll need to equip it in the Accessories section, and you'll need to always keep it equipped to get the extra slots.
Image via Kraken Express
For starters, you'll need a workbench. Scroll down to the Torn Sailcloth Bag from Plans and Recipes, and choose the recipe. Then, you'll need the following items to craft the bag.

How to craft the Sailor Backpack in Windrose
If you've obtained the Torn Sailcloth Bag and are still not satisfied with your inventory, you can also craft the Sailor Backpack. You can equip it to get eight extra inventory slots. You need to equip it from the Accessories section. You'll need the following materials to make the Sailor Backpack
One Torn Sailcloth Bag

entry.title: Idols Of Ash review - a terrific spelunking horror game that makes you choose between a rock and a giant centipede
entry.summary:
When I think of Idols of Ash, I think of seven sounds, listed here in order of deepening dreadfulness. The first and nicest sound is the clink of my silvery grapple sinking its hook, interrupting the rush of air past my ears as I fall. That's the second, less nice sound. The third sound is a distant, tectonic groaning, disconsolate and wakeful: it could be the wind again, pushing through some unaccountably musical lungful of stone. Yeah, I'm sure that's all it is.
The fourth sound is definitely not the wind: a squeaky, squidgy rumination, like the cooing of idle pigeons. You hear that cooing and you start running, because it generally precedes the fifth sound, the stiletto rattle of chitinous feet. When the legs are close, there's the sixth sound, a rasping, gaping hiss, and it's time to yeet yourself into the chasm while hurling your grapple towards the nearest jutting surface. With any luck, you will not then hear the seventh sound: the thud of your hook bouncing off the rock.

entry.title: A Storied Life: Tabitha review – a cosy yet pensive puzzler where the biggest challenge is getting someone else's story straight
entry.summary: It is, as I write this, one year to the day since I and two fellow, newly-orphaned siblings finished the process of auditing, packing, and clearing out our childhood home. The final task: enduring the fearsome rattling and suspect braking of our dad’s neglected Renault Megane, just long enough for it to sputter to someone mad enough to buy it off us. The irony, that this clanking full-stop on the end our bereavement’s lengthy administrative aspect could so feasibly kill me, was not lost. That process, from the last beep of hospital machinery to the unhaggled exchange of French scrap metal, took 11 months, so it’s good that A Storied Life: Tabitha condenses its own house clearance to just a couple of hours. Posthumously asked by an elderly friend to give her cottage a tidy, you spend half your time in A Storied Life rummaging through her things in a kind of reverse Unpacking, selecting which bric-a-brac to throw away, which to keep, and which – with her blessings – to auction off for cash. The other half is spent taking inspiration from the objects you’ve kept to rewrite her water-damaged memoirs, a bittersweet series of word puzzles that still achieves a certain warmth – provided you can come to terms with the peculiar writing style. entry.title: How to play co-op with friends in Windrose
entry.summary:
Sea-faring adventure Windrose can be played solo, but you can also share your exploits with friends. The dedicated servers can support co-op for up to four people. However, you can also have more if you manage your own servers.
Either way, let's look at how you can explore the sea with your buddies on the same ship.
Table of contents How to invite your friends to Windrose How to join a friend's game in Windrose
How to invite your friends to Windrose
The process of playing with friends begins by inviting them to your game (I am assuming that you're the host). For starters, add all of them to Steam, as it will make the process simpler. You can send them a friend request using their IDs.
Screenshot by Destructoid
You can play online, but if you want to invite your friends, you'll need to host a game. Select a save: you can either use your own save or create a new one for the co-op experience. Once done, you'll get an invite code (refer to the image above).
Screenshot by Destructoid
Share this ID with your friends, and they will then have to enter the code. Once done, all of you can play together. You can create your own server name, and also add a password for an extra layer of protection. As I said, the official servers can have a maximum of four players at any given time.
How to join a friend's game in Windrose
Screenshot by Destructoid
If you're not hosting a game, you'll need your friend's code to join their adventure. Enter the code, and you'll be able to join the server and play together. If they have a password on their server, you'll need to enter it before you get to join the adventure.

entry.title: "Framerate Estimator" evidence in Steam's new update points to more detailed performance tests than Valve's Verified programmes
entry.summary: Steam is, most likely, going to get a lot more prophetic about how its thousands of games might run on your PC. ResetEra user dex3108 spotted, deep within the Valve app’s newest client update, a number of unused text strings relating to a "Framerate Estimator" tool. Putting aside my sadness that no-one’s ever thought to call me The Framerate Estimator, in the appropriate title case, it sounds like this would take a rough punt on how many frames per second the user’s hardware can churn out in a given game. While such an addition hasn’t been confirmed by Gabe & Co. themselves, it was only a couple of months ago that Steam began (optionally) collecting anonymised framerate data; I still think this began with Verified programmes for the Steam Deck, Steam Machine, and Steam Frame in mind, though that data could absolutely feed a more bespoke tool like this. And serving up specific framerate ranges – even estimates – for any PC player, regardless of hardware, would take Valve’s performance previews into both much wider and much more detailed territory. entry.title: "Keeping teams together doesn't seem to matter to people, but for us it did": Star Wars Zero Company's director on what the industry can learn from XCOM 2
entry.summary: It seems that every week we're reporting on news of another wave of layoffs at a big game studio. In March alone, we saw 1000 staff let go at Epic Games, 124 at Eidos Montreal, and over 100 at Ubisoft's Red Storm Entertainment. And those are just the ones I can name without needing to rack my brain. In some cases, these "reorganisations" are to keep investors happy, in others they're painted as necessary for a studio to keep the lights on until its next paycheck. But every time a team loses members, they lose something that can't be replaced if the money ever begins to flow again. The shorthand and trust that develops between staff who work together for a long time, the institutional knowledge of what's been tried in the past and worked (or didn't), these only come from teams that remain intact. Many have sung the praises of institutional knowledge and holding a team together before, but in the wake of layoffs like we're seeing at the moment, it seems worth providing an example of why letting a team mature together makes for better games. entry.summary: Zajímavý, stylově konzistentní počin s unikátní atmosférou předchozích Omerzuových filmů, ale se dvěma výtkami: 1) Herecké výkony nejsou tak univerzálně kvalitní jako dřív. 2) Podstatná část filmu (cca poslední třetina) je skoro hardcore psychologický thriller, ke kterému "absurdní nedějovost a nelogičnost zápletky" moc nesedí. (Ilča 40 %)

entry.title: Audio recenze: Pan Nikdo proti Putinovi - 50 %
entry.summary: Film, s jehož myšlenkou bezvýhradně souhlasím ("Ruská propaganda i ruský politický systém jsou zrůdné"), ale jehož forma je vrcholně nezajímavá, znalému nepřinese žádné nové informace o Rusku a jeho propagandě, neznalého nepřesvědčí, jako "pohled na osud jednoho člověka" zcela selhává a sám se stává ("tou správnou") propagandou. (Ilča 30 %)

entry.title: An update on Steam / GOG changes for OpenTTD
entry.summary: I wanted to provide an update on the situation with OpenTTD on Steam and GOG, and what the Atari re-release of Transport Tycoon Deluxe means for OpenTTD. There has been a lot of speculation and, in some cases, misinformation spread about what has happened. Our initial announcement perhaps didn’t provide as much detail as we could have, but I want to reassure OpenTTD fans that we have not been “pressured” by Atari to make these changes.

entry.title: Kermitův dokumentární gulag
entry.summary:
Před pár dny dostal Oscara za dokumentární film dánsko-český snímek Pan nikdo proti Putinovi, který vypráví o tom, jak funguje ruská propaganda a odhaluje ruskou realitu. V tomto dokumentárním filmu se v čase 32:01 mluví o sovětských gulazích, což je doprovázeno fotografií typického gulagu. Je to stará černobílá fotografie, na které vidíme vězně, vstupní bránu, a nad ní nápis "GULAG".
Záběr z dokumentu "Pan nikdo proti Putinovi" (čas 32:01)
Je na tom něco divného? Možná to, že nápis "GULAG" není v azbuce, ale v latince. Ale kdo ví, já se moc nevyznám v sovětské historii. Ovšem docela se vyznám ve filmech s plyšovými žabáky, takže jsem viděl (shodou okolností v letadle do Japonska) hraný film z roku 2014 A zase ti Mupeti (Muppets Most Wanted), ve kterém se v čase 28:37 objeví tento zábě…
